::: {.callout-note}
## Course Information

**Instructor:** Prof. Nipun Batra, IIT Gandhinagar

**Semester:** January 2026

**Target:** First-year BTech students (no ML background assumed)

**Repository:** [github.com/nipunbatra/principles-ai-teaching](https://github.com/nipunbatra/principles-ai-teaching)
:::

## About This Course

A **practical introduction to AI and Machine Learning** designed for beginners. We build intuition first, then formalize with math and code. By the end, you'll understand how ChatGPT works and be able to build simple AI systems yourself.

---

## Lectures

| # | Topic | Slides | Key Concepts |
|:-:|-------|:------:|--------------|
| 1 | What is AI? | — | AI landscape, applications, what we'll build |
| 2 | Data Foundation | [HTML](lectures/02-data-foundation/slides.html) ∙ [PDF](lectures/02-data-foundation/slides.pdf) | ML paradigms, features/labels, train/test split, sklearn |
| 3 | Supervised Learning | [HTML](lectures/03-supervised-learning/slides.html) ∙ [PDF](lectures/03-supervised-learning/slides.pdf) | Linear/Logistic regression, trees, KNN, metrics |
| 4 | Model Selection | [HTML](lectures/04-model-selection/slides.html) ∙ [PDF](lectures/04-model-selection/slides.pdf) | Overfitting, cross-validation, bias-variance |
| 5 | Neural Networks | [HTML](lectures/05-neural-networks/slides.html) ∙ [PDF](lectures/05-neural-networks/slides.pdf) | Perceptrons, backprop, PyTorch basics |
| 6 | Computer Vision | [HTML](lectures/06-computer-vision/slides.html) ∙ [PDF](lectures/06-computer-vision/slides.pdf) | CNNs, object detection, YOLO |
| 7 | Language Models | [HTML](lectures/07-language-models/slides.html) ∙ [PDF](lectures/07-language-models/slides.pdf) | Next-token prediction, embeddings, attention, transformers |

## Labs / Demos

Interactive Jupyter notebooks for hands-on practice.

| Lecture | Notebook | Description |
|:-------:|----------|-------------|
| L02 | [L02_data_foundation.ipynb](lecture_demo/L02_data_foundation.ipynb) | sklearn API, train/test, clustering |
| L03 | [L03_supervised_learning.ipynb](lecture_demo/L03_supervised_learning.ipynb) | Regression, classification, metrics |
| L04 | [L04_model_selection.ipynb](lecture_demo/L04_model_selection.ipynb) | Cross-validation, grid search |
| L05 | [L05_neural_networks.ipynb](lecture_demo/L05_neural_networks.ipynb) | PyTorch, training loops, MNIST |
| L06 | [L06_computer_vision.ipynb](lecture_demo/L06_computer_vision.ipynb) | CNNs, YOLO inference |
| L07 | [L07_language_models.ipynb](lecture_demo/L07_language_models.ipynb) | Tokenization, bigrams, embeddings |
